item.title: The Early History of Smalltalk (1993)
item.description:
📝 50 Most ideas come from previous ideas. Smalltalk was part of this larger pursuit of ARPA, and later of Xerox PARC, that I called personal computing. There were so many people involved in each stage from the research communities that the accurate allocation of credit for ideas is intractably difficult.
🔗 Read more: https://worrydream.com/EarlyHistoryOfSmalltalk/
